messages:
samir: dropped a short proposal for regrouping the left rail by 'Surface' (Models, Data) and 'Actions' (Deploy, Jobs). main goals: reduce vertical scan, keep routes predictable for external links, and make breadcrumbs more contextual. seeking quick takes on URL contract and accessibility

hana: love the declutter. Q: will grouping change canonical paths? we should avoid breaking bookmarks/runbooks. prefer alias/redirect layer rather than renaming canonical routes

oli: agreed on aliasing. routing idea: keep canonical server routes flat and human readable, add a normalization layer on the client that maps legacy shapes to canonical paths. example canonical examples in the sketch:
/models/m-77
/deployments/d-3/instances
/models/m-77/versions/v2

beau: note on back-button/history: prefer history.replaceState for ephemeral tab switches and history.pushState for share actions (copy permalink / activate shortcut). prevents backstack spam when toggling panels

mira: a11y checklist: when a deep link lands in a nested view, set focus to the main heading of the revealed panel and use aria-live polite to announce context (e.g., "Opened Versions for Model Foo"). ensure breadcrumb nav has aria-label="Breadcrumb" and last crumb has aria-current=\"page\"

hana: breadcrumb UX thought: show resource and a small removable context pill for the panel (e.g., "Model • Foo    [versions]"). pill should be keyboard-focusable and have clear tooltip copy: "View: Versions (remove to go to model root)"

samir: routing contract draft: canonical base routes: /models/:id, /deployments/:id. allow read-only query params (range, env). use hash for truly transient client state (#panel=versions). client should provide a permalink composer that can include or omit hash/query based on user choice

oli: security note: shortlink tokens ok for sharing long filters but must be time-limited and audited. token example: /s/abc123 -> resolves to /models/m-9?filter=error&range=7d#panel=logs (expires)

beau: copy nit: label the rail group 'Surface' in collapsed UI? might be confusing. alternative surface label: 'Resources'. tooltip for group: 'Resources (models, datasets)'

mira: keyboard flow: when arriving from a shortlink redirect, avoid double focus jumps. focus once on H1 and update skip-link target to main content. announce redirect with polite aria-live so screenreader users understand they were forwarded

hana: analytics: record link_medium: direct|shortcut|breadcrumb|shortlink and include boolean included_ui_state. helps product understand whether people prefer exact state links or stable canonical links

samir: about breadcrumbs collapsing: if a resource lacks a parent, render a lightweight placeholder crumb with accessible tooltip explaining missing parent instead of removing crumb entirely. ensures consistent structure and fewer layout jumps

oli: dev note: implement server redirects for legacy routes for at least 6 months, and add a normalization map in the client for future-proofing. document the RFC and include integration tests for alias redirects

beau: QA checklist for PR: deep-link landing focus, aria-live announcements, history behavior after panel toggle vs share, shortlink resolution + expiry, tooltip copy presence, keyboard nav for pill removal

nav-bot: added draft RFC: https://docs.redwood/nav/rfc/route-normalization-v1 (comments open) :robot_face:

mira: i'll run an accessibility pass on the proto tonight and post comments in Figma. thanks everyone :sparkles:
